about: Pashto narration for Hide and Seek, laid over the pages and pictures of the English Curious Reader book HideAndSeekLevel4En (same 11 story pages: Dodo looks for Mom, then finds 10..1 things). Page numbers are body indexes of the converted English book (0 = title page; 12 = English credits page, not narrated). There is no Pashto H5P version: all text is taken from the sentence recordings' file names and cross-checked against the word clip names (every word except the title words has a clip). Numbers 10, 9 and 8 are written as digits as in the recordings. 'link' lists the Pashto words that trigger the page's picture (replacing the English glow hotspots). Needs checking by a Pashto reader.
